system.description:
You gain +10 to [Magic Power] when you land a critical hit with [Magic Attack], adding +20 to the damage roll. [Trigger: Setup] This effect lasts until the end of the round. Once per scene. A bracelet adorned with a magic stone that emits a blue glow like a full moon. It has an effect that enhances the wearer's magic power.
